AnalysisSummary.title: AnalysisSummary
AnalysisSummary.description:
Exact counters and rates for the filtered event snapshot.

``error_rate`` is ``(error_count + critical_count) / matched_event_count``.
It deliberately does not represent HTTP success semantics.

ApplicationHealth.title: ApplicationHealth
ApplicationHealth.description: Health snapshot for the application service.

ApplicationRuntimeStatistics.description: Runtime snapshot for the application service.

BatchItemResult.description: Immutable result emitted per logical batch item.

BatchParseResult.description: Collected output for a batch parse execution.

BatchParseStatistics.title: BatchParseStatistics
BatchParseStatistics.description: Immutable statistics summary for a batch parse execution.

errors.title: Errors

ComparisonApiRequest.description: Version-one HTTP schema for period comparison requests.

ComparisonApiResponse.description: Safe public comparison response without user metadata echo.

DetectionDecision.title: DetectionDecision
DetectionDecision.description: The final outcome of evaluating all available parsers for a log input.

DistributionResult.title: DistributionResult
DistributionResult.description:
A bounded top-N distribution over all filtered events.

Item percentages use ``total_count`` as their denominator so missing values
remain visible in the result.

EndpointAnalysis.title: EndpointAnalysis

EventAggregationResult.description: Represent the aggregation produced for an event query.

tags_any.title: Tags Any
tags_any.description: Event must have at least one of these tags.

tags_all.title: Tags All
tags_all.description: Event must have all of these tags.

EventFilter.title: EventFilter
EventFilter.description: Immutable model for defining event filtering criteria.

offset.title: Offset
offset.description: Starting offset of the returned page.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items requested for the page.

returned.title: Returned
returned.description: Actual number of events selected for this page.

EventPage.description: Describe pagination for one deterministic query snapshot.

EventQuery.title: EventQuery
EventQuery.description: Define a bounded, typed query against an event store snapshot.

EventQueryResult.description: Represent an immutable result for one event snapshot query.

EventSort.title: EventSort
EventSort.description: Defines a single sort criterion for an event query.

EventStoreStatistics.description: A snapshot of the event store's runtime statistics.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: Explicit event ID to use. Overrides store's identity_mode.

deduplicate.title: Deduplicate
deduplicate.description: Whether to perform content-hash based deduplication for this event.

duplicate_policy.title: Duplicate Policy
duplicate_policy.description: Override the store's default duplicate policy for this event.

apply_retention_before_write.title: Apply Retention Before Write
apply_retention_before_write.description: If true, apply the retention policy before this write operation.

source_batch_id.title: Source Batch Id
source_batch_id.description: Optional identifier for the source batch this event belongs to.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Custom metadata to associate with the stored event.

EventWriteOptions.title: EventWriteOptions
EventWriteOptions.description: Immutable options for a single event write operation.

FacetBucket.title: FacetBucket
FacetBucket.description: Represent one value/count pair in a facet.

GroupComparison.title: GroupComparison
GroupComparison.description: Change in the prevalence and metrics of one categorical group.

HTTPAnalysis.title: HTTPAnalysis
HTTPAnalysis.description: HTTP coverage, status rates, distributions, endpoint rankings and trend.

HTTPStatusBreakdown.title: HTTPStatusBreakdown
HTTPStatusBreakdown.description: HTTP status class counts for one method or service group.

IngestionMetadata.title: IngestionMetadata
IngestionMetadata.description: Immutable diagnostics describing a single ingestion operation.

IngestionResult.title: IngestionResult
IngestionResult.description: Immutable logical document produced by the ingestion layer.

IngestionSource.title: IngestionSource
IngestionSource.description: Immutable description of a single ingested source.

IngestionWarning.title: IngestionWarning
IngestionWarning.description: Immutable ingestion warning emitted during source preparation.

LatencyAnalysis.title: LatencyAnalysis
LatencyAnalysis.description: Duration coverage, descriptive statistics, histogram, and rankings.

LatencyBucket.title: LatencyBucket
LatencyBucket.description: One non-overlapping latency histogram bucket in milliseconds.

LogEvent.title: LogEvent
LogEvent.description: Immutable domain model for normalized log events.

MetricComparison.title: MetricComparison
MetricComparison.description: Change in one well-defined metric between two analysis periods.

ParseError.title: ParseError
ParseError.description: Represents a parse failure or validation issue.

ParserContext.title: ParserContext
ParserContext.description: Immutable execution context passed to parsers at runtime.

ParserMetadata.title: ParserMetadata
ParserMetadata.description: Immutable metadata describing a parser contract and capabilities.

ParserRegistration.description: Immutable registration record for a parser in the registry.

ParserSelection.title: ParserSelection
ParserSelection.description: Immutable result of selecting a parser through the manager.

ParserSessionInfo.title: ParserSessionInfo
ParserSessionInfo.description: Immutable summary of a parser session in a batch stream.

PercentileSummary.title: PercentileSummary
PercentileSummary.description:
Exact or explicitly sampled descriptive statistics for numeric values.

``standard_deviation`` represents population standard deviation. Count,
extrema, mean, and standard deviation can be computed over every valid
value with constant memory. When bounded sampling is used, median and the
requested percentile values are order-statistic estimates over the smaller
deterministic sample recorded by ``percentile_sample_count``.

PipelineOptions.title: PipelineOptions
PipelineOptions.description: Immutable options that control a single pipeline execution.

PipelineResult.title: PipelineResult
PipelineResult.description: Immutable outcome of a full processing pipeline run.

PipelineStage.title: PipelineStage
PipelineStage.description: Ordered stages for a single log processing pipeline run.

PipelineStageResult.title: PipelineStageResult
PipelineStageResult.description: Immutable result of one pipeline stage.

RankedItem.title: RankedItem
RankedItem.description: One deterministically ordered entry in a top-N result.

SlowEvent.title: SlowEvent
SlowEvent.description: Safe summary of a high-latency event without raw log content.

id.title: Id
id.description: The unique identifier of the event in the store.

inserted_at.title: Inserted At
inserted_at.description: The UTC timestamp when the event was inserted into the store.

sequence.title: Sequence
sequence.description: A monotonically increasing sequence number for insertion order.

content_hash.title: Content Hash
content_hash.description: The SHA-256 hash of the canonical event content.

estimated_size_bytes.title: Estimated Size Bytes
estimated_size_bytes.description: The estimated memory size of the event in bytes.

source_batch_id.title: Source Batch Id
source_batch_id.description: The identifier of the batch this event originated from.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Custom metadata associated with the stored event.

StoredEvent.title: StoredEvent
StoredEvent.description:
Immutable model representing a log event as it is stored in the event store.

It wraps the original `LogEvent` and adds storage-specific metadata.

TimelineBucket.title: TimelineBucket
TimelineBucket.description: Statistics for one inclusive-start, exclusive-end UTC bucket.

TimelineResult.title: TimelineResult
TimelineResult.description: A deterministic ordered sequence of analysis time buckets.
